q: What recall@10 did the deck show for the retention model, and what did the notebook show?
a: The deck showed 0.37 and the notebook 0.41; the deck counted all positives in the denominator while the notebook used only scored positives.

q: What AUC is shown in the deck for the limit model, and what sits beside it?
a: The exposure-weighted AUC of 0.744, with the unweighted AUC of 0.781 shown beside it.

q: What uplift@20% and interval did the Q3 2025 offer test show?
a: About 2.0 percentage points, with a 95% interval of 1.1 to 2.9 points from 500 account-level bootstrap resamples.

q: What is the current name for the 30-day spend sum feature?
a: feat_txn_spend_sum_30d_v2; the v1 version summed reversals as well and was retired in May 2025.

q: Why was the dispute-count feature rebuilt?
a: It read 14 days past the observation date, which inflated holdout AUC from 0.72 to 0.79; the rebuilt v2 reads only days on or before observation.

q: What churn rate does the December 2025 cohort show under the current label?
a: 6.1 percent under the 90-day churn label; the 60-day label had shown 9.8 percent for the same cohort and is retired.

q: Is a same-month bureau score allowed as a feature?
a: No, the score must be dated at least 30 days before observation; a same-month pull added 0.02 AUC and was rejected as leakage.

q: Can holdout-2025q4 be re-extracted to pick up late labels?
a: No; the set is frozen, and a re-extract would change labels so metrics would no longer be comparable with earlier runs.
